correctness.rationale: Write N(v+tz)=Av+tu+(ell(v)+ct)z. Torsion on (v,z) forces omega(v,u)u=0 for every v, so u=0 by nondegeneracy. The residual torsion on V is exactly omega((A-cI)v,(A-cI)w)z. This is the isotropy of the image of B=A-cI, not the image of A. It needs no division or characteristic restriction. The number of rank-r maps B is the count of isotropic r-frames divided by the number of bases of a fixed r-space, times the full-row-rank count of surjections onto this space. Appending ell to B increases rank by one precisely outside its r-dimensional row space; the free c multiplies both counts by q. This gives both joint strata, also at r=0, and their sum. The characteristic polynomial factors as (T-c) times the shifted characteristic polynomial of B, for which the zero multiplicity is at least 2n-r. In a separate bounded computation the direct torsion test exhausted 512 and 19683 operators in dimension three over F2 and F3, with exact joint histograms (2,6,36,36) and (3,24,288,576) in order (0,0),(0,1),(1,1),(1,2). Exhaustion of all binary 4-by-4 B, followed by all ell,c for the isotropic B, gave (2,30,900,6300,25200,75600) in lexicographic order of feasible strata, total 108032. Both methods agree with the formulas.
residual_risks: The dimension-five replay enumerated parametrized candidates, not all five-dimensional endomorphisms; finite tests do not establish the universal result. The independent replay has no separate archived executable; the frozen package supplies checker.py for its own small-case check.
